title: Bandai Namco Announces One Piece: Grand Gourmet Cooking Management Simulation Game
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday One Piece : Grand Gourmet , a new cooking management simulation game in the One Piece series, by Kairosoft. The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PC via Steam , iOS, and Android on October 23.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Creator Breaks Silence on Season 2 Renewal With New Release
content: Gachiakuta was one of the biggest Shonen action franchises that made its anime debut last year, and the creator behind it all has broken their silence on the series coming back for its second season.
author: ComicBook

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Teams Up With Anime Royalty For Its Strangest Crossover
content: The Gundam universe has seen its fair share of crossovers that pit the classic anime mechs against other anime heavy hitters. The weapons of war have shared space with the likes of Hatsune Miku, Call of Duty, Code Geass, Hello Kitty , and too many others to count.
author: ComicBook

title: FromSoftware's The Duskbloods Switch 2 Game Gets Closed Network Test in Summer
content: FromSoftware revealed during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday a trailer for The Duskbloods PvPvE multiplayer action game , and it reveals that the game will get a Closed Network Test in summer 2026. The Duskbloods will launch exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo-Based Developer Shapefarm's Orbitals Switch 2 Game Reveals September 3 Release in Trailer
content: Tokyo-based developer Shapefarm unveiled during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday a trailer for its new two player cooperative game Orbitals , and it reveals the September 3 release. The video previews gameplay: The game will launch exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
author: ANN

title: Fairy Tail Creator Teases Natsu & Lucy’s Romantic Future Ahead of Revival
content: Fairy Tail is now in the works on a major comeback with a new revival series, and the creator behind it all is teasing that Natsu and Lucy might think of one another as more than friends.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon's Dogma 2 Game Gets Switch 2 Version With New 'Dark Arisen' Expansion
content: CAPCOM announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday that it will release the Dragon's Dogma 2 sequel game on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 9. The Switch 2 release will include the base game and the new "Dark Arisen" expansion.
author: ANN

title: Square Enix Announces Final Fantasy Resonance HD-2D Offline Game Based on Final Fantasy Brave Exvius
content: Square Enix announced during its Nintendo Direct livestream Final Fantasy Resonance , a new HD-2D offline title based on the first story arc of the defunct Final Fantasy Brave Exvius smartphone game.
author: ANN

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Game Gets Switch 2 Release on September 25
content: CAPCOM announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday that it will release its Onimusha : Way of the Sword game for Nintendo Switch 2 on September 25. The game will also launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on the same day. There is a playable demo.
author: ANN

title: New One Piece Spinoff Reveals First Look (& It’s All About Zoro)
content: One Piece has announced that a new spinoff is now in the works, and it’s all about the fan-favorite Straw Hat Roronoa Zoro. One Piece is having a great year so far as not only has the anime returned for its adaptation of the Elbaph Arc from Eiichiro Oda’s original manga series, but there are all sorts of new projects…
author: ComicBook
